name: SensorLink
title: A spare phone becomes a remote sensor.
short: Stream phone sensors to another phone
full: Leave a phone in the room and read its sound (dBFS), tilt (degrees) and motion (m/s², gravity included until tared) on another phone. Local numbers work offline. Remote updates need a connected room. Readings are relative, not calibrated instruments.
